description: config_sha256 hashes the complete parsed per-match game object with sorted keys, compact separators, unescaped Unicode, and UTF-8. The claim is stored outside the hashed object. This is distinct from config_file_sha256 (exact file bytes) and from the per-turn commitment (which mixes a secret commitment nonce and the '|' delimiter).

not_adopted_lecturer_hashes.note: These lecturer-supplied values are not adopted as universal hashes.
not_adopted_lecturer_hashes.invalid_length_65: 9f2c is a 65-character value and cannot be a SHA-256 digest.
not_adopted_lecturer_hashes.bd23_sample: Retained only as a labeled sample; not reproduced here because its exact source object was not supplied.
